verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official browser web clipper or extension. It also shows no way to capture article content or highlights from the browser. The closest feature is Bookmark Objects, which fetch a URL's title, description, preview image and favicon as Properties. That saves link metadata, not clipped page content or highlights, so it is a related but different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can clip web pages, articles, and highlights from my browser straight into my notes with an official clipper or capture flow
